t: The Titan TTI1206GHT 18V cordless hedge trimmer provides efficient performance for garden maintenance and landscaping tasks. Equipped with a powerful brushless motor and 45cm laser-cut blades, it delivers a precise 20mm cutting capacity, making it ideal for shaping hedges and shrubs around domestic properties or commercial sites. This lightweight machine includes an anti-vibration system for comfortable use, and a blade tip protector for enhanced durability, ensuring smooth operation for prolonged periods. A low battery indicator aids in effective work planning.
b: Laser Cut Blades For Optimum & Precise Cutting Performance
